auth_methods.quote: To authenticate your request, you will need to provide an authentication token with the required scopes or permissions. There are a few different ways to get a token: You can create a personal access token, generate a token with a GitHub App, or use the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN in a GitHub Actions workflow. After creating a token, you can authenticate your request by sending the token in the Authorization header of your request.
